chk_hr_inputs_values.name: chk_hr_inputs_values
chk_hr_inputs_values.value: coalesce("hr_payroll_inputs"."work_days", 0) >= 0 AND "hr_payroll_inputs"."overtime_hours" >= 0 AND coalesce("hr_payroll_inputs"."revenue", 0) >= 0 AND "hr_payroll_inputs"."output_qty" >= 0 AND "hr_payroll_inputs"."health_insurance" >= 0 AND "hr_payroll_inputs"."income_tax" >= 0 AND coalesce("hr_payroll_inputs"."quarter_bonus", 0) >= 0

idx_customer_activities_follow_up.name: idx_customer_activities_follow_up
idx_customer_activities_follow_up.where: "customer_activities"."next_at" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_activities"."next_done_at" IS NULL

chk_pos_close.name: chk_pos_close
chk_pos_close.value: ("pos_shifts"."closed_at" is null and "pos_shifts"."report_snapshot" is null) or ("pos_shifts"."closed_at" is not null and "pos_shifts"."report_snapshot" is not null and "pos_shifts"."counted_cash" >= 0 and ("pos_shifts"."cash_difference" = 0 or length(trim("pos_shifts"."difference_reason")) > 0))
